attBesluta.text: Very well built. It deeper than I expected, it is 3.5” deep so it sticks through the wall a couple inches, but not a problem in my application. When unpacking, I almost broke the screen handles trying to open the screen. Thought they were locked, with the key inside. The handles pull out towards the operator to make a raised handle and unlatch the screen. Would have been nice if this was mentioned somewhere. Luckily I figured it out just before breaking a latch. Would also be nice if the screens could be removed, but not a big deal. Overall very satisfied
These are a decent quality window for the price. Shipped quick too

I purchased the 50" Pet Tub with Ramp, and it was delivered to me, in Hawaii in less than seven days. Although there were a few minor scratches upon arrival, I am very pleased with the overall quality of the product. Assembly and plumbing installation took less than two hours and were straightforward to complete. Most importantly, my 70-pound ‹NAMN› appeared calm and comfortable throughout the bathing process. Overall, I am very satisfied with my purchase and would recommend this pet tub to other pet owners.

Just installed the 50" tub with ramp. Unit is well made and went together pretty easy with no surprises. They supply plenty of hardware. I used their drain on the tub but transitioned to standard PVC fittings and p-trap from it, ( a 2" pvc threaded fitting mates right up). Water connections are standard 1/2". Overall, very pleased, definitely watch for a sale

Overall was easy to put together packaging, no problems. No damages. The only thing is, it would be nice if it had some type of bolt or tie off system to the wall anchoring. Would definitely recommend this product again. 5 out of 5 actually thinking about buying another one when we expand our business.
Love this new tub. Appears to be quite stable and leak proof. Easy to install. Opted for the ramp rather than the stairs. Works well for our older dogs. Would recommend this product

Works perfectly in our space & fits even our largest dogs (Bull Mastiff, St Bernard, Great Pyraneses) with ease. Easy to adjust water temperate as well as moving around handle to wash dogs everywhere.
